record.question: How many notified towns are there in Mizoram?
record.explanation: Answer C: 23. Mizoram government sources report 23 notified towns. Reference: https://planning.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/40d7e0a85e3049ea6cade9df4f0b96c0/annual-plan-2012-13.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
